notes: (ErrMessage) prints "[ Error ] %s"

name: mm_Movie_SwitchThread
notes: (switchThread) RotateThreadReadyQueue syscall (0x2B)

name: mm_Movie_TermAll
notes: (termAll) waits for the decoder to drain, stops audio, removes the handlers, deletes the threads and closes the stream

name: mm_Movie_Update
notes: one step of playback: pumps the demux until the decoder reports the end, then terminates

name: mm_Movie_ReadAndDemux
notes: reads disc data into the read buffer (sceCdStRead), demuxes it (sceMpegDemuxPssRing), sends audio to the IOP and starts display and audio once both are preloaded

name: mm_Movie_ResumeAll
notes: restarts display and audio after a pause

name: mm_Movie_InitAll
notes: (initAll) display buffers, sceMpegInit, video decoder, audio decoder (when 0x1BD9E8 is set), stream callbacks, read and decode threads, VSync and DMA handlers

name: mm_Movie_PcmCallback
notes: (pcmCallback) stream callback for audio: skips the 4-byte sub-stream header, copies the packet into the audio decoder (ring-aware); returns 0 when there is no room

name: mm_Movie_VideoCallback
notes: (videoCallback) stream callback for video: copies the packet into the IPU input buffer, records its time stamp ("pts buffer overflow"); 0 when there is no room

name: mm_Movie_ReadBufEndGet
notes: (readBufEndGet) releases a1 bytes

name: mm_Movie_ReadBufBeginGet
notes: (readBufBeginGet) start of the readable data and its size

name: mm_Movie_ReadBufEndPut
notes: (readBufEndPut) commits a1 written bytes

name: mm_Movie_ReadBufBeginPut
notes: (readBufBeginPut) write position unless the ring is full

name: mm_Movie_ReadBufDelete
notes: (readBufDelete) empty

name: mm_Movie_ReadBufCreate
notes: (readBufCreate) empty ring of 0x50000 bytes

name: mm_Movie_StrFileRead
notes: (strFileRead) sceCdStRead of a1/2048 sectors (or sceRead for host files); flags a read error

name: mm_Movie_StrFileClose
notes: (strFileClose) sceCdStStop and frees the stream buffer (or sceClose)

name: mm_Movie_StrFileOpen
notes: (strFileOpen, was mm_OpenDiscFile) cdrom0: files via sceCdSearchFile and CD streaming, host0: files via sceOpen

name: mm_Movie_ViBufGetTs
notes: (viBufGetTs) time stamp of the data the IPU is reading now

name: mm_Movie_ViBufPutTs
notes: (viBufPutTs) records a time stamp for the data just written

name: mm_Movie_ViBufModifyPts
notes: drops time stamps whose data the IPU has consumed

name: mm_Movie_ViBufFlush
notes: (viBufFlush) rounds the write offset up to 2 KB

name: mm_Movie_ViBufCount
notes: (viBufCount) bytes waiting for the IPU

name: mm_Movie_ViBufDelete
notes: (viBufDelete) stops IPU DMA, deletes the semaphore

name: mm_Movie_ViBufRestartDma
notes: (viBufRestartDMA) restarts the toIPU DMA where it stopped

name: mm_Movie_ViBufStopDma
notes: (viBufStopDMA) stops the toIPU DMA and remembers its position

name: mm_Movie_ViBufAddDma
notes: (viBufAddDMA) queues more ring data on the toIPU DMA chain ("DMA ADD not active")

name: mm_Movie_ViBufEndPut
notes: (viBufEndPut) commits a1 bytes

name: mm_Movie_ViBufBeginPut
notes: (viBufBeginPut) free space as up to two areas

name: mm_Movie_ViBufReset
notes: (viBufReset) empties the ring and the time stamp table, builds the DMA tags

name: mm_Movie_ViBufCreate
notes: (viBufCreate) ring a1 (uncached), DMA tag area, time stamp table, semaphore

name: mm_Movie_CbTimeStamp
notes: (mpegTS) libmpeg time stamp callback: mm_Movie_ViBufGetTs

name: mm_Movie_CbRestartDma
notes: (mpegRestartDMA) libmpeg callback

name: mm_Movie_CbStopDma
notes: (mpegStopDMA) libmpeg callback

name: mm_Movie_CbNoData
notes: (mpegNodata) libmpeg callback: switch threads, then queue more input

name: mm_Movie_CbError
notes: (mpegError) libmpeg callback: prints the message

name: mm_Movie_DecodeLoop
notes: (decBs0) decode thread loop: sceMpegGetPicture into the picture queue, builds image and subtitle packets, ends on sceMpegIsEnd ("decode thread: aborted")

name: mm_Movie_VideoDecMain
notes: (videoDecMain) decode thread entry: resets the buffers, runs the loop, waits for the queue to drain, state 3 (done)

name: mm_Movie_VideoDecIsDone
notes: input buffer empty and libmpeg has no more pictures

name: mm_Movie_VideoDecPutTerminator
notes: appends a sequence end code (0x1BD9F0) to the input once there is room; 0 until then

name: mm_Movie_VideoDecPutTs
notes: (videoDecPutTs) time stamp for input offset a3

name: mm_Movie_VideoDecGetState
notes: (videoDecGetState) +0xA8

name: mm_Movie_VideoDecDelete
notes: (videoDecDelete) deletes the input buffer and the sceMpeg (0x10BF60)

name: mm_Movie_VideoDecEndPut
notes: (videoDecEndPut) commits a1 bytes of input

name: mm_Movie_VideoDecBeginPut
notes: (videoDecBeginPut) input free space as up to two areas

name: mm_Movie_VideoDecAddStrCallback
notes: wrapper around sceMpegAddStrCallback; returns 1

name: mm_Movie_VideoDecCreate
notes: (videoDecCreate) sceMpegCreate, the five libmpeg callbacks, state 0, input buffer

name: mm_Movie_VoBufDecCount
notes: (voBufDecCount) one shown picture released

name: mm_Movie_VoBufGetTag
notes: (voBufGetTag) oldest decoded picture (0x39240-byte slots), 0 if none

name: mm_Movie_VoBufGetData
notes: (voBufGetData) next free picture slot (0x12C000 bytes each), 0 if full

name: mm_Movie_VoBufIncCount
notes: (voBufIncCount) marks the slot decoded and advances

name: mm_Movie_VoBufIsFull
notes: (voBufIsFull) count == size

name: mm_Movie_VoBufReset
notes: (voBufReset) empties the queue

name: mm_Movie_VoBufDelete
notes: (voBufDelete) empty

name: mm_Movie_VoBufCreate
notes: (voBufCreate) picture data a1, tag area a2, a3 slots
